basics.name: Ivan Gegov
basics.label: AI systems builder, orchestration and infrastructure
basics.summary: AI systems builder shipping agent orchestration, source-grounded research, retrieval and memory, voice interfaces, and full-stack public products.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Self-directed engineering and operations across AI products, agent orchestration, research systems, retrieval, memory, voice and delivery infrastructure.
highlights: Built and operated multi-agent systems with typed contracts, task routing, provider-aware fallback, evidence receipts, review gates and explicit unknown states.
Built the Glass Mem memory system around append-only event capture, SQLite/FTS5, embeddings, vector retrieval, source-linked recall and MCP access.
Built document ingestion and evidence-linked retrieval for health, training and editorial products, carrying source context into user-facing tools.
Built evidence-first GitHub PR operations with independent gather/decide/review/act stages, head-pinned decisions, CI-step evidence, GitHub API/SSE/MCP integration and human escalation.
Built provider-neutral model workflows using Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, Gemini and local OpenAI-compatible services, with model routing and measured evaluation.
Built public products including The Drop, SD Forest / Forest HUB, GymScholar, Open Dashboard, Repo Shelf, MoneyWolf, Avatar Playground and the combined Health route.
Built voice and multimodal systems using realtime model APIs, streaming speech pipelines, open voice models, browser audio and messaging surfaces.
Worked across Windows/PowerShell, Vercel, GitHub Pages, Oracle/VPS/KVM2, Docker/Compose, Caddy, systemd, GCP Secret Manager, n8n, GitHub Actions, Tailscale and RunPod.
Built the native Glass Council client surface in Kotlin Compose Multiplatform for Windows and Android alongside its Python engine and MCP server.

projects.name: The Drop
projects.description: A daily and weekly publication in English and Bulgarian, with research and editorial content, Telegram delivery and ElevenLabs narration.

projects.name: SD Forest / Forest HUB
projects.description: A home for my projects, learning tools and research pages, built with static web pages, FastAPI and SQLite. It includes interactive 3D views and AI indexes.

projects.name: GymScholar
projects.description: A training app for building workout routines, setting custom schedules and rest/break intervals, and targeting specific muscle groups. Its training engine uses evidence-based claims drawn entirely from peer-reviewed exercise science papers, rather than gym lore or bro-science.

projects.name: Open Dashboard
projects.description: An MCP server published on npm as open-dashboard-mcp, with thousands of downloads. It gives agents up-to-date model capabilities, provider pricing and adapters, and integrates with the Model Router to compare and route models by cost and capability. The web dashboard is a companion interface for inspecting the same data.
highlights: Live model capability and provider pricing data

projects.name: 3D Repo Shelf
projects.description: A hand-curated catalog of around 1,500 useful GitHub repositories and developer tools, picked one by one rather than scraped or filtered by topic. It spans open source and engineering; many entries are not AI-related at all. Browse the interactive 3D bookshelf or use search, categories and graph views.

projects.name: MoneyWolf
projects.description: Agents read live sources — current prices, stock market data and crypto market data — assess risk and record simulated trades in SQLite. Risk gates stay in force: it remains read-only and paper-only and does not place real orders. Repeated events do not duplicate actions.
highlights: Live stock and crypto market data

projects.name: Avatar Playground / Voice Playground
projects.description: A browser tool for testing how Chloe’s avatar responds to audio, voice, gestures and connection changes, connected to its running system.

projects.name: Audiobook Studio
projects.description: Turns ebooks, EPUB and PDF files into audiobooks, with several text-to-speech backends and browser listening.

projects.name: Flexy Read
projects.description: A dyslexia-focused reading app with reader controls and layout adjustments to adapt how text is displayed.

projects.name: Women's Health OS
projects.description: An app in development for browsing women’s health papers, facts and evidence-linked claims. The public page is available, but its data-loading state needs review: an online API does not mean the research data is ready.
projects.dataQualityFlag: The user-reported zero-facts/zero-papers state is retained as a review warning. Fresh async readback on 2026-10-21 eventually showed non-zero counters; do not hide the warning or fix the product in this task.

projects.name: Glass Mem
projects.description: Agent memory that stores original events without overwriting them. SQLite/FTS5 search, embeddings and vector retrieval find context linked back to source events, with access through MCP.

projects.name: Glass Council
projects.description: A system for comparing input from independent models, with a Python engine, MCP server and Kotlin Compose Multiplatform client for Windows and Android. It is in development with private source, not the Claude Code planning framework.
projects.publicSurfaceNote: No public browser URL was verified; do not substitute the public round-table council route or the Claude Code council repository.

projects.name: Glass PR Solver
projects.description: Automation that takes a PR all the way to merged. Several models review each change independently and must agree before it is approved and merged automatically. It rebases the branch, addresses requested changes and fixes failing CI, looping until the work is done. It asks for human help when a run is blocked or out of date.

projects.name: Cognitive Autonomy / Firsthand
projects.description: A tool in development for recording a person’s observations before model interpretation. It stores original evidence separately from the model’s interpretation.
